title: Nitrile rubbers and production thereof in organic solvents
abstract: The invention relates to a novel method for producing nitrile rubbers by way of radical polymerization in an organic solvent and in the presence of special controller substances. Said polymerization can be followed by hydrogenation to also produce novel hydrogenated nitrile rubbers; hydrogenation likewise advantageously takes place in organic solvents. The obtained, optionally hydrogenated, nitrile rubbers are characterized in that they have fragments of the controller substances used in the polymer main chain or as end groups. Nitrile rubbers can be produced as having a wide variety of molecular weights and polydispersity indexes, in particular as having very low polydispersity indexes.
